lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish new_screen, finish notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 2 tests; despite leaning positive, neither test was statistically significant.
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no test achieved a statistically significant win.
Predictions were overly optimistic in round 1, but underestimated measured outcomes in round 2 when predicting lower or negative gains.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick-Start Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated interaction onboarding screen right after setup completion to demonstrate desktop pet interactions and tray visibility controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or talk to the pet, and 3 reported pets not appearing on desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your new pet is now roaming your desktop. Use system tray icons to hide, summon, or talk to your companion anytime.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_desktop_controls']

candidates.title: Companion Archetype Trait Selection
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a split visual archetype layout where users select pet personality traits alongside visual styles.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion and long median completion time (89s), while custom pet generation results trigger user complaints.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion's Personality & Form
pick_friend.body: Select a visual style and personality trait to shape how your desktop pet interacts with you.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet selection layout while preserving the ability to choose a friend.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 39.1% and has user complaints, but prior redesign test showed a drop (-2.8%).

candidates.title: Visual Stage Hatching Sequence
candidates.change: Rebuilds the waiting step into a staged visual journey displaying companion creation milestones as the pet comes to life.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) and 81.3% conversion, suggesting users leave or stall while awaiting generation.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life
waiting.body: Synthesizing graphics, desktop behaviors, and AI personality traits...

guard.reason: Rebuilds the waiting step animation while preserving its job of showing the pet being created.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 18.7% with long wait time, but rebuilding flow requires major release effort with unproven success.

candidates.title: Post-Certificate Account Registration
candidates.change: Moves sign-in screen to occur immediately after adoption certificate completion before desktop rendering begins.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets mention missing pets after re-login; registering right after finalizing the pet certificate ensures immediate account binding.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in within onboarding as explicitly permitted by rule 4 without skipping steps.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 tickets and sign_in dropoff; reorder showed mild positive result (+0.4%) in 1 test.

candidates.title: Account Pet-Link Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit security hint on the sign-in screen confirming that account login permanently saves created desktop pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your created pet and customizations are permanently saved to your account.

guard.reason: Adds an informational hint to the sign-in screen without requesting new personal data or violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence with minimal implementation cost via hint UI addition.

candidates.title: Desktop Diagnostic Rendering Status
candidates.change: Displays real-time technical status updates on the waiting screen showing display driver and desktop integration steps.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pet failing to appear on desktop or app failing to open during initial setup.

waiting.hint: Verifying desktop overlay permissions and initializing companion display engine...

guard.reason: Adds diagnostic information to the waiting screen while keeping its core creation job intact.

candidates.score_note: Targeted home wait_info previously resulted in -0.9% across 2 tests with no clear benefit.

candidates.title: Background Rendering System Notification
candidates.change: Adds desktop system notification prompt alerting users when background pet asset rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Finish step mean time is extremely long (5815s), showing users switch to other apps while setup completes.

home_intro.headline: Pet Generation Complete!
home_intro.body: Click to place your companion on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a background rendering completion notification to the home intro within onboarding scope.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff step (35.2% loss, 5815s mean time); prior notification test was positive (+2.0%).

candidates.title: Path Differentiation Value Copy
candidates.change: Clarifies the path options by contrasting instant pre-built companion adoption against custom AI pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Adopt?
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Adoption to pick a ready-to-play pet in seconds, or Custom Creator to generate a unique companion.

guard.reason: Clarifies the onboarding options while continuing to offer both adoption and custom pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy tweak addressing hesitation, leaning slightly positive (+1.1%) across 2 tests.

candidates.title: Certificate Starter Kit Reward Badge
candidates.change: Displays a free starter toy bundle badge on the adoption certificate screen upon completing pet customization.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences high drop-off (60.9% conversion), requiring a clear reward trigger to finish.

guard.reason: Mentions free extras or gifts ('Includes Starter Toy & Treat Pack') in onboarding copy, violating rule 3.

candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll Path Selector
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a full-height scrollable showcase featuring animated pet previews.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at the path choice screen before engaging with pet creation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen and home new_flow, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, despite results consistently leaning positive.
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info across 2 tests or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect in one test and caused a significant drop in another, requiring an early stop.
Predictions were frequently overly optimistic for minor tweaks, yet severely underestimated major positive outcomes like the winning adoption redesign.
